image_description: A small passerine bird, identified as a brambling (Fringilla montifringilla), is perched on a thin, leafless branch against a clear blue sky. The bird exhibits the plumage characteristics of a breeding male, with a black head and throat, bright orange-rufous breast, and black upperparts featuring distinct white shoulder patches. Its bill is short, conical, and appears dark grey/black. The legs are slender and pinkish-brown, gripping the branch firmly.
